sample_values.template:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- INDI configuration file — defines devices, drivers, and global options -->
<drivers>
{% for driver in drivers %}
  <!-- Driver: {{ driver.name }} (enabled: {{ driver.enabled }}) -->
  <driver name="{{ driver.name }}" enabled="{{ 'true' if driver.enabled else 'false' }}"{% if driver.library %} library="{{ driver.library }}"{% endif %}>
{% for device in driver.devices %}
    <!-- Device: {{ device.name }} (unique ID: {{ device.uid }}) -->
    <device name="{{ device.name }}" uid="{{ device.uid }}"{% if device.model %} model="{{ device.model }}"{% endif %}{% if device.port %} port="{{ device.port }}"{% endif %}{% if device.baud_rate %} baud_rate="{{ device.baud_rate }}"{% endif %}{% if device.connection_type %} connection_type="{{ device.connection_type }}"{% endif %}>
{% for property in device.properties %}
      <!-- Property: {{ property.name }} (type: {{ property.type }}) -->
      <property name="{{ property.name }}" type="{{ property.type }}" value="{{ property.value }}"/>
{% endfor %}
    </device>
{% endfor %}
  </driver>
{% endfor %}
</drivers>

drivers.description: List of INDI drivers to configure (e.g., telescope, camera, filter wheel)

enabled.description: Whether this driver is enabled at startup

library.description: Path to shared library file for the driver (optional)

properties.description: Persistent property values for this device

value.description: Initial value(s) for the property (comma-separated for switches)
